eid_r.declaration: Loreley computes its own identity: evaluator_name = WORKER_EVALUATOR_PLUGIN (evaluator.py:1481-1485), evaluator_version = source fingerprint of that module (evaluator_identity.py:90-105), campaign_program_hash = sha256 of loreley.program.md (campaign_program.py:212). The adapter renders loreley.program.md from the frozen EID* document (Goal / Primary metric / Correctness gates / Evaluation budget sections come from EID*.Config and EID*.MetricDefinition), so the triple is a function of EID*; eidr_derivation is the sha256 over (eid_star, plugin_source_sha256, campaign_program_sha256, native_scheme) and recomputes.
eid_r.recompute_cmd_note: tools/verify_eidr.py imports a0/contract/evalcontract.py (the authority on how an EID* is formed) and nothing from a0_adapter; it re-derives the value from the document, the plugin source file and the rendered program bytes

failure_stage_counts_basis.definition: one unit per member of C*: 14 unit(s) for 14 candidate(s), counted from the score trace by (run_id, iteration, candidate_id) - the same rule the conformance runner uses in count_failure_stages(). Adapter-level events that are not candidates (the run-level resource event, the report-branch selection row) are not units.

failure_stage_mapping.note: E* verdict -> trace failure_stage. The trace schema fixes the enum but not this per-runtime mapping; SimpleLoop freezes it here and reports it to the contract owner so the other runtimes can adopt the same one.

hard_constraint_1_cwd_independence.note: E* is executed with cwd=/ and PATH='' from a third directory; both the primary value and the canonical digest are compared

hard_constraint_3_multi_field.note: the runtime's metric vector keeps E*'s multi-field Outcome; the declared F_r adds exactly one projection metric and the adapter is the only place a scalar is formed
